children: Rallybio declared an estimated $82.7 million special cash distribution, or approximately $13.56 per share, in connection with its proposed merger with Avenzo Therapeutics.
The estimated distribution is based on net cash above zero under the merger agreement; the final amount may be higher or lower.
Payment is scheduled for November 13, 2026, to eligible stockholders and pre-funded warrant holders, subject to the required stockholder vote.
The record date is expected to be November 5; Nasdaq is expected to set November 6 as the ex-dividend date, with due bills expected for trades November 4–6.
Rallybio also set the close of business on the record date for its previously announced contingent value rights distribution.
